name: smwsprites-smb1-flagpole-v1
title: SMB1 Flagpole v1.2
description:
This is the flagpole from SMB1. It can trigger the secret exit.

See the readme for more details.

GreenHammerBro's fix: Fix a bug that when the time limit hits zero while Mario is sliding down the pole, Mario
glitches and may not able to go back to the map, freezing the game. Now it freezes the time limit by storing #$28 in $7E:0F30.
